content.title: Upgrades
content.body:
§lHealth: 
      - Heart Containers
      §lCombat:
      - Iron Melee/Ranged Weapons: Found as rare treasure loot in many dungeons.
      - Halo Necklace (Bauble): Dropped by §oChampion Mobs §r(Mobs with colored particle effects).
      - Pride Pendant (Bauble): Crafted using §oGolden Crowns §r(Rare treasure loot).
      - Arcane Workbench: Allows the player to add spells and upgrades to their wands.
      - Craftable Spells: Ignite, Snowball, Arc, Dart, Light, Heal, Smoke Bomb, Leap, Muffle.
      - Mage Baubles: Found in §oObelisks §ror §oShrines§r.
      - Novice Spells: Treasure loot.
      - Arrow Quiver (Bauble): Traded by the §oFletcher§r.
      - Enchantments
      §lDefense:
      - Holy Shield (Shield/Bauble): Rare treasure loot. Also Craftable.
      - Cross Necklace: Dropped by §oChampion Mobs§r. Also Craftable.
      §lMisc:
      - Finding Villages: Holding a §oLost Tablet §rin your inventory causes it to reveal §oStructures §rand §oBiomes§r, including §oVillages§r.
      - Small Backpack: Traded by the §oLeatherworker§r.
      - Decorative Graves: Used to gather §osouls §rto power §otablets §rand §oscrolls§r. 
      - Ankh of Prayer: Mainly used to level up §oKnowledge of Death§r.
